title: Voyager golden record carrying the Navajo Night Chant

tellings.quote: Each spacecraft carried what was known as a golden record containing the sights and sounds of planet Earth.

plain: In 1977 each of the two Voyager space probes was sent off carrying a golden record holding the sights and sounds of Earth, among them the Navajo Night Chant, a Native American ceremonial song. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as an example of humanity sending a message to whoever might be out there.
